title: King of the AI Jungle — Pre-Workshop Self-Assessment
description: Collected at Day-0 kickoff to establish a pre-workshop skill baseline for growth reporting.

qa_fundamentals.description: Self-rated skill in QA fundamentals — writing test steps, identifying risks, traceability. (1–5).

ai_awareness.description: Self-rated AI tooling skill level. (1=Basic prompts, 5=Multi-agent workflows).

tooling_skills.description: Self-rated CLI and tooling fluency. (1=No CLI experience, 5=Advanced tooling).

test_design.description: Self-rated test design capability. (1=Basic test cases, 5=Exploratory + automated test design).

risk_analysis.description: Self-rated risk analysis skill. (1=Basic risk listing, 5=Quantified risk model with mitigations).
